**Finding submitted — deviation on Section 10.3 (Assignment).**

- **What exists:** Section 10.3 (p0063) is the only assignment provision, and it is a bare successors-and-assigns binding clause. Searches for "assign", "consent", "successor", "transfer", "subcontract" and "change of control" turned up nothing else operative; the Section 4.1 termination right is a mutual 90-day notice right, not change-of-control triggered.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no consent requirement, no notice mechanic, and no restraint on HDI — HDI could assign the hosting Agreement, potentially to a competitor of ours, without our involvement.
- **Cure (preferred, one insert after 10.3):** we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without HDI consent; no change of control of ours gives HDI a termination right; HDI may assign only with our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor. Drafted as an addition so the existing binding language is untouched, and preferred was chosen because it closes the HDI-side gap without imposing a new consent gate on us (as a mutual fallback would).
